pages.text: This parchment can hold multiple positions for your servants to patrol around. Simply record your positions and right-click the parchment on your servant for them to start patrolling. To stop your servants from patrolling, simply change their movement mode or shift right-clicking on them with the plan.

Using a $(l:crafts/command_horn)Command Horn$() on None mode while having a filled Patrol Plan offhand will cause all selected servants to patrol at the positions. Blowing it while shift right-clicking will stop selected servants from patrolling.
